theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury - Light variant)
theme_and_archetype.description: A modern, minimalist, and trendy e-commerce site for a young premium clothing brand. Emphasizes clean layouts, generous whitespace, soft elegant interactions, and a soft beige/rose-gold color palette pulled from the brand's logo. The goal is quiet luxury and frictionless shopping.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous white space. Allow the imagery to serve as the dominant visual element. Never overcrowd sections.

surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5 sticky top-0 z-50
surface_styles.product_card: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-black/5 hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300
surface_styles.event_banner: bg-[#FCE4EC] rounded-3xl p-10 sm:p-16 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between

navbar.layout: Flex container with Logo on left, Navigation links center, Cart/Profile/CTA right.

hero.layout: Full height or min-h-[85vh] with background image cover.
hero.overlay: bg-gradient-to-t from-black/40 via-black/20 to-transparent or subtle scrim so white text is legible but image remains bright.
hero.content: Centered or left-aligned. H1 Slogan, small description, Primary CTA 'Découvrir la collection' (Solid #C4A18A, text white), Secondary CTA 'Commander maintenant' (White background, text #C4A18A).

about.layout: Asymmetric 2-column or grid. Left: Large Boutique Image. Right: Brand philosophy, emphasis on quality and elegance, plus key stats (e.g., 'Nombre de produits', 'Clients satisfaits', 'Nouvelles collections').

products.cards: Image aspect ratio 3/4, object-cover, rounded-xl. Product name (Outfit font), Price (font-semibold), Stock status. Absolute positioned badges. Primary CTA 'Commander' (full width, subtle bg, text-white on hover).

new_arrivals.layout: Highlighted slider or staggered grid. Cards slightly larger than standard products with 'New Arrival' overline.

events.layout: Full width modern banner container. Background in #FCE4EC. Large elegant text with upcoming dates.

testimonials.layout: Grid of 3 cards. Simple text, customer name, small avatar.

footer.layout: Multi-column layout. Logo, social icons, links, newsletter form. Large py-20.
footer.background: bg-[#FAF9F6] text-[#1A1A1A] with a top border.

interactive_motion.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-in for product grids.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: data-testid='navbar-cart-icon', data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='product-card-1-add-to-cart', data-testid='newsletter-submit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts like Hero and About sections to allow creative asymmetry.
Use Lucide icons for UI elements.
Use framer-motion for scroll-triggered entrances and smooth hover interactions.
Implement real shopping cart logic with state management and session tracking.
Use exactly the media URLs provided in this file. Never use placeholders.
Do NOT include a Blog section.
For typography, import 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts.
Create e-commerce functionality using a lightweight state store (e.g. Zustand or Context API) and mocked products database.
Ensure hover states and transitions are soft and luxurious as detailed.
